chapter: New Orleans bands: Cheek, Parker, Morgan
title: Working the Silver Street with Cheek and George Lewis; moving to guitar
summary: Jones worked at the Silver Street in Cheek's band with George Lewis; he put down banjo when guitar became popular.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. What about, did you ever know George Lewis in the old days?

Yeah, I'll tell you about it. I used to work at the Silver Street. Listen to this. Yeah. With Cheek as the band leader. Mm-hmm. George Lewis on clarinet. Mm-hmm. Manny Gabriel on saxophone. Now it's been so long I forgot who was on the drum. But I used to work at the Silver Street. That was down in the Araby.
What were you playing? You were playing guitar then?

I started on the banjo but I put it down because guitars got popular and you know, in the, around the early 30s guitars got popular and I fell in love with the guitar and I just put the banjo down. Well I had a good start on the banjo. Oh. What about this drummer named Antoine? Did you ever know him? Oh yeah. You live in?
